aboutColumns.title: The idea

aboutColumns.title: The product
aboutColumns.text: We design the interface, build the experience, and test the details that make it feel effortless to use.

home.servicesIntro: From the first sketch to the live product, we design and build the parts of a digital experience that people see, use, and rely on.
home.promoText: Tell us what you have in mind. We’ll work through what it takes to bring it to life.
home.capabilitiesTitle: What we bring to a project

about.intro: Independent by design. We bring visual design and development together to build digital products with purpose.
about.headline: Built for what's next.
paragraphs: FUEL X STUDIO is an independent digital design and development studio creating modern websites, mobile applications, and digital experiences for ambitious businesses.
Founded at the intersection of advertising experience, creative direction, and digital design, our studio transforms ideas into functional digital products.
We combine refined visual design with modern development practices, strategic thinking, and efficient execution.
From the initial concept to the final launch, every project is approached with precision, purpose, and attention to detail.
We believe exceptional digital products should look remarkable and perform exceptionally.
about.philosophy: A good interface gives people a clear path. We use typography, composition, and motion to draw attention to what matters and make the next step feel natural.
about.approach: We prototype the important interactions early. Then we build, test, and refine the product on the screens and devices your audience uses.

portfolio.intro: A closer look at the websites, applications, and interfaces we design and build.
portfolio.emptyText: We’re preparing our project stories. If you’d like to discuss a similar brief, get in touch with the studio.

servicePage.intro: We shape each project around its audience, its purpose, and the way your business works.

services.title: Web Design
services.short: Websites with a distinct visual identity.
services.description: We give your content a clear structure and your website a visual language of its own. Layout, typography, and interaction work together on every screen.
services.process: We map the pages and their priorities, explore a visual direction, and refine responsive designs with your feedback.

services.title: Web Development
services.description: We turn approved designs into fast, accessible websites that your team can maintain. The content and integrations shape the technical approach.
services.process: We agree on the technical requirements, build reusable components, and test the complete site before launch.

services.title: Mobile App Design & Development
services.short: Mobile products designed around everyday use.
services.description: We design and develop mobile applications around the tasks your users need to complete. We agree on the right platforms and delivery approach during discovery.
capabilities: Custom mobile app design and development
services.process: We map the core user journeys, test a touch-ready prototype, and build the agreed features for the selected platforms.

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.short: Interfaces that make the next step clear.
services.description: We look at how people move through a product and where they need help. That understanding guides its flows, interface, and design system.
services.process: We work through the user flows, explore wireframes, and refine the interface into a consistent set of components.

services.title: Custom Digital Solutions
services.description: When an existing tool doesn’t fit the work, we design one around it. We translate your requirements into a digital product with a clear role in your business.
services.process: We study the workflow with you, define the smallest useful version, and develop and refine it around real tasks.

founders.name: Nihad Mushazade
founders.bio: Nihad brings experience in advertising agencies, creative business development, and digital strategy. His work connects client communication and project management, helping turn a business goal into a clear project brief.

founders.name: Tural Mushazade
founders.bio: Tural works across visual design, creative design, and digital product design. He shapes how a product looks and feels, from its first visual direction to the details of the interface.

process.title: Discover
process.text: We learn about your business, your audience, and the problem the product needs to solve. Together we agree on priorities and scope.

process.title: Design
process.text: We explore visual directions and turn the chosen approach into layouts and interactive prototypes you can review.

process.title: Develop
process.text: We build the approved experience, connect its features, and adapt it for the screens and platforms in the brief.

process.title: Refine
process.text: We check the details together, test real user journeys, and make the adjustments that matter before launch.

process.title: Launch
process.text: We prepare the release, check the live product, and hand over the materials your team needs to use it.

principles.title: Clear communication
principles.text: We agree on priorities together, share progress, and keep a clear record of decisions.

principles.title: Attention to detail
principles.text: We review type, spacing, interaction, and behavior across screen sizes.

principles.title: Efficient execution
principles.text: We work in reviewable stages so feedback reaches the product while it can make a difference.

principles.title: Customized solutions
principles.text: Your audience and business requirements guide the design and technical choices.

principles.title: Professional delivery
principles.text: We define the handover in advance and walk you through the finished product.

faq.q: Can you design a website around our brand?
faq.a: Yes. We start with your brand, content, and audience, then design the structure, typography, and layouts that suit the website you need.

faq.q: Can you build a website from an existing design?
faq.a: Yes. We review the design files, responsive layouts, and required integrations with you before agreeing on the development scope.

faq.q: Do you design and develop mobile applications?
faq.a: Yes. We can work on an interface, a prototype, or the application itself. We agree on iOS, Android, or a cross-platform approach according to your requirements.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: Timing depends on scope, content readiness, integrations, and review rounds. Once we understand the brief, we propose a schedule with clear milestones.

faq.q: How do I request a quote?
faq.a: Send a short description of the project, your goals, and any timing constraints. We’ll review your requirements and prepare a private proposal.

faq.q: Can you build a custom tool for our business?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us how the current workflow works and who uses it. We can explore a custom application, dashboard, or platform around those needs.

faq.q: How will we stay in touch during the project?
faq.a: At the start we agree on a contact channel and review schedule. You can follow progress, give feedback, and approve work at the agreed stages.

faq.q: What happens at launch and handover?
faq.a: We test the agreed features, check the release, and hand over the files, access, and guidance defined in the project scope.
